jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Athens Grafton School District, a union school district in the Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (member towns Athens and Grafton; formed as the Windham Northeast Union Elementary School District, renamed 2023 after Westminster's 2022 withdrawal).
Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (official site; the district's documents post to its board portal).

sources.note: Warning for the May 24, 2022 district meeting (Athens and Grafton, then the Windham Northeast Union Elementary School District), Article 6: the voters modified the articles of agreement to add one district-wide-elected resident seat per town, producing the current board of six -- three seats allocated to Athens residents, three to Grafton residents, all elected by the district's voters as a whole (modified at-large). The 2022 article framed the added seats as one term; the board has sat at six continuously since, and no fetched document makes the structure expressly permanent.

Athens Grafton School District board minutes, April 30, 2026 (Windham Northeast SU document portal): 'Present: Cathy Siano-Goodwin, Lynn Morgan, Krista Gay, Hardy Merrill, Rachel Plummer, and Mark Berman' with none absent -- the full six-member board; identical full attendance in the November 13, 2025 minutes.

Athens Grafton School District board minutes, April 30, 2026 (Windham Northeast SU document portal): 'Present: Cathy Siano-Goodwin, Lynn Morgan, Krista Gay, Hardy Merrill, Rachel Plummer, and Mark Berman' with none absent -- the full six-member board; identical full attendance in the November 13, 2025 minutes.

Athens Grafton School District board minutes, April 30, 2026 (Windham Northeast SU document portal): 'Present: Cathy Siano-Goodwin, Lynn Morgan, Krista Gay, Hardy Merrill, Rachel Plummer, and Mark Berman' with none absent -- the full six-member board; identical full attendance in the November 13, 2025 minutes.

Athens Grafton board minutes (April 30, 2026; also November 13, 2025) seat Mark Berman as a director, and he signed the district's January 2026 annual-meeting warning with a term to 2027. His allocation to the Athens seat-group rests on residence evidence (Athens Selectboard minutes, March 20, 2025, appoint him to the Athens Planning Commission); no fetched school source town-labels him.

Athens Grafton board minutes (April 30, 2026; also November 13, 2025) seat Cathy Siano-Goodwin as a director. Her documented two-year term (Grafton Town Report 2024) expired in 2025 and no fetched election source documents her re-election; she serves continuously through April 2026 and is recorded on that continuity.
